paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: : Left: Accuracy of all methods on each group of bias type in BBQ. Right: results on BBQ's testing set. All methods are applied on LLaMA-2-Chat-7B. For accuracy (A%_{}), higher values are better; for unknown-answer response rate (U%_{}), bias score (BS%_{}) and stereotypical response rate (SR%_{}), lower is better. We use bold font for the best result in each column, and mark the methods that improve ICL. : significant improvements on ICL in A% by pair-wise t-test with p < 0.05.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and MCI for three different methods: Linear SAE, LLaMA-2-chat-7B, and ICD. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 2000 with a tick label interval of 500. The y-axis is labeled "MCI" and also has a linear scale, ranging from 37 to 39 with a tick label interval of 1. The Linear SAE line is represented by a dark blue color with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 37 at 0 demonstrations and increasing to around 39.5 at 2000 demonstrations, with a notable peak at 1000 demonstrations where it reaches about 38.1, followed by a slight decline to 38 at 1500 demonstrations before rising again. The LLaMA-2-chat-7B line is depicted in pink with a dotted line style, remaining relatively constant at around 36.8 across the entire range of demonstrations. The ICD line is shown in light blue with a dashed line style, staying steady at approximately 38 across all values on the x-axis.
